subject: science
passage: A vacuum flask keeps a drink hot for hours because of its double wall. Most of the air has been removed from the space between the inner and outer walls. Since heat travels through air by conduction and convection, this nearly empty space slows the escape of heat. Many flasks also have shiny inner surfaces, which reflect heat radiation back toward the drink.
stem: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?

choices.A: To explain how the design of a vacuum flask keeps drinks hot
choices.B: To argue that vacuum flasks are better than all other containers
choices.C: To describe the shiny inner surfaces found in some flasks
choices.D: To compare conduction and convection as ways that heat travels

explanation.why: The first sentence states the idea ("A vacuum flask keeps a drink hot for hours because of its double wall"), and every later sentence explains a feature of the flask that slows heat loss. So the text's purpose is to explain how the flask's design works.
explanation.A: Correct. The whole text explains how the flask's features, the airless space and the shiny surfaces, keep heat in.
explanation.B: Incorrect. The text never compares flasks with other containers or argues that one is best.
explanation.C: Incorrect. The shiny surfaces are mentioned only in the last sentence; they are one detail, not the main purpose.
explanation.D: Incorrect. Conduction and convection are named only to explain why the empty space helps; the text does not compare them.

checks.note: Best fit on the text alone.
